definitions.explanation: The official or formal steps required to complete something.

examples.japanese: {入国|にゅうこく}{手続|てつづ}きを{済|す}ませる。
{契約|けいやく}の{手続|てつづ}きに{時間|じかん}がかかった。
{必要|ひつよう}な{手続|てつづ}きはすべて{完了|かんりょう}しました。
examples.english: All necessary procedures have been completed.

notes:
{手続|てつづ}き refers to formal procedures, especially official or administrative ones.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {手続|てつづ}きを{取|と}る: to go through the procedure
- {手続|てつづ}きを{済|す}ませる: to complete the procedure
- {入国|にゅうこく}{手続|てつづ}き: immigration procedures
- {出国|しゅっこく}{手続|てつづ}き: departure procedures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手順|てじゅん}: steps (more informal, technical)
- {手続|てつづ}き is more formal/official
